jobs.name: Won It on Tiebreaker
jobs.symbol: An equals sign paired with an upward rank arrow.
jobs.description: Your final tournament rank was decided by a tiebreaker—TR margin, Buchholz, or TPerf—after a tie on tournament points.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: ONE minimalist achievement emblem for the center of an existing game badge.
Primary request: a pictogram for “Won It on Tiebreaker”: equal tournament points separated by a tiebreaker in the standings.
Input image: MATERIAL AND STYLE reference only. Match its smooth ivory enamel faces, warm-gold edging, restrained raised bevels, thin dark edges, and upper-left highlights. Do not reproduce the chart or bar heights.
Subject: On the LEFT, one unmistakable large EQUALS SIGN, made of exactly TWO thick short horizontal rounded ivory bars with narrow gold rims, equal length, aligned one above the other with a generous transparent gap. On the RIGHT, one bold warm-GOLD ARROW pointing straight UP, with a short thick vertical shaft and a broad triangular arrowhead. The arrow is clearly separated from the equals sign by transparent space. Its arrowhead rises above the top bar of the equals sign, expressing a rank rising out of a points tie. All three shapes form one compact balanced icon.
Composition: front-on orthographic view, centered on a square transparent canvas, at least 15 percent clear margin around the whole icon. The equals sign is about half the icon width, the upward arrow about one third; both remain clear at small sizes.
Style: broad solid pictogram shapes, smooth polished surfaces, shallow bevels, no fine texture. Same ivory-and-gold family as reference.
Background: actual transparent alpha PNG. Fully transparent outside objects and in all gaps. No backdrop, black fill, glow, haze or cast shadow.
Avoid: outer badge frame, bar chart, tilted bars, balance scales, podium, crown, coins, money, numbers, letters, captions, extra shapes, scenery, presentation sheet. Exactly the two horizontal bars and one upward arrow.
